name: Amadeus IT Group, S.A.
summary: Amadeus IT Group, S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a transaction processor for the travel and tourism industry in Europe, Central and South America, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia Pacific. It operates in three segments: Air Distribution, Air IT Solutions, and Hospitality & Other Solutions. The company acts as an international network providing real-time search, pricing, booking, ticketing, and other processing solutions through Amadeus GDS, Alt?a Passenger Service System, and New Skies platforms.
